Perks

WX-78 is able to eat stale and spoiled Food without the related penalties, though is not immune to all Food penalties (such as eating Monster Meat). This allows them to stockpile food for increased lengths of time.

WX-78 may consume Gears to recover 60 , 75 and 50 per item. Upon death, they will drop anywhere from 33-50% of the gears they've ingested during their life (rounded down), up to a cap of 40.

Additionally, being struck by lightning will drain 33 and restore 100 .

WX-78 has half the aggro range from Clockworks and Damaged Clockworks. For instance, the Clockwork Rook's normal range of 12 meters will be reduced to 6 meters towards WX-78.

WX-78's favorite food is Butter Muffin, which means they gain 15 bonus when consuming the food.

Charge Meter

WX-78 Charge Meter with Circuits.

WX-78's main perk takes the form of their charge meter situated on the right of the UI. It slowly refills with charge over time. The meter has 6 bars where circuits can be plugged into, taking anywhere from 1 to all 6 of the bars depending on the circuit. Once the circuit's bars are filled, the circuit will apply its effects.

Note: Multiple circuits of the same type will stack their effects unless stated otherwise.

Every 90 seconds, WX-78 will gain one unit of charge as long as they are not Starving or Wet. WX-78 can receive one unit of Charge by using a Lightning Rod that has been recently struck, being struck by lightning, or consume electric food like Electric Milk or Volt Goat Chaud-Froid. They can also be fueled by Winona's Generators and Winona's G.E.M.erators, which will use 90% of the generator's maximum charge and 6% of the G.E.M.erator's maximum charge.

If WX-78 becomes Frozen, two units of charge will be lost. Charge units will also be lost when using the Circuit Extractor to remove circuits, with the amount being equal to the amount of charge the Circuit was actively using. Circuits also lose 25% of their durability when extracted.

Alpha, Beta and Gamma Bars

WX-78's Chassis Body

When plugging in the circuits or using the Circuit Extractor, WX-78 opens their chassis, which contains 3 categorized bars: Alpha (red), Beta (blue) and Gamma (yellow). Each circuit corresponds for which bar it belongs to, based on what shapes are on top of the head, the color slab and pins.

When a Circuit is applied to the bar, it will attempt to take up the lowest unoccupied pins available. Removing a Circuit via Circuit Extractor will remove the highest, and thereby latest Circuit applied.

When hovering over the charge meter, it will show which circuits are currently plugged in. The charge meter affects all three bars; when charge is gained or lost then this will activate or deactivate all three circuits in line with that charge.

Circuits

WX-78 starts a new world with two of their items:

Circuit Extractor - Extracts the top circuit in WX-78's system and removes an amount of charge equivalent with how many slots it took up.

Bio Scanalyzer - Allows WX-78 to scan living creatures to acquire blueprints for the below circuits.

Disadvantages

  • Without any circuits, WX-78 has stats on the lower end of the spectrum and may succumb to insanity or starvation quicker than other characters.
  • WX-78 takes damage from Rain at a rate of 3-9 damage based on their wetness and a charge slot every 5 seconds when above 15 wetness, which can pose a significant threat. Great care should be taken to avoid wetness.

  • Each Processing Circuit has a 20% resistance to negative sanity aura, while each Super-Processing has a 50% resistance.
  • Each Gastrogain Circuit reduces hunger drain by 5%, while each Super-Gastrogain gets boosted to have 25% slower hunger drain.
  • The Beanbooster Circuit gives a 50% resistance to negative sanity aura.

Alpha Circuits Tinkering II 		Unlock "Alpha Circuits Tinkering I" Hardy Circuits, Processing Circuits, and Beanbooster Circuit gain a new effect in addition to their original effect. Gastrogain Circuits are boosted. The effect of some Alpha circuits additional effect:
  • Each Hardy Circuit grants a 2.5% protection, while each Super-Hardy grants 5%.
  • Each Processing Circuit boosts sanity gain from clothing items by 10%, while each Super-Processing grants 25%.
  • Each Gastrogain Circuit reduces hunger drain by 10%, while each Super-Gastrogain gets boosted to have 30% slower hunger drain.
  • The Beanbooster Circuit provides a sanity gain from clothing by 25%, and gives a shield when WX-78 is at full health. When the shield is over 15 points, WX-78 gets a one shot protection from incoming damage. The shield regenerates for 0.25 points/second (or 15 points/min). It doesn't work during combat.

  • The Thermal Circuit reduces the damage of Freezing by 50% (100% with two).
  • The Refrigerant Circuit reduces the damage of Overheating or Burning damage by 50% (100% with two).

  • The Chorusbox Circuit recruits nearby mobs such as Pig or Bunnyman to be followers. A new chorus layout will also be play.
  • The Rangebooster Circuit increases the radius of the Bio Scanalyzer and other Drones (Roto-Mapper, Zaptrocuter, Auto-Grabber and Exploiterator) radius, and increases the range of W.A.R.B.I.S. Head Gear and W.A.R.B.I.S. Armor target locking.

  • Each Acceleration Circuit reduces the speed penalty caused by carrying heavy objects, spider web and Bee Queen's sticky trail by 25% (50% with two, 75% with three).
  • The Electrification Circuit will burst out a base 50 AoE electrical damage (100 with two, 150 with three) when WX-78 get hit 10 times.
  • The Illumination and Super-Illumination Circuit gives WX-78 a flash light facing in their direction. Plugging in more Illumination Circuit and Super-Illumination Circuit increases the radius of the light and its cone.

Affinity

Skill Prerequisites Description Notes

Lunar Vessel
  • Find and defeat the Celestial Champion.
  • Have no shadow affinity.
  • Be able to craft a Backup Chassis.
 Using "borrowed" technology from the Cryptic Founder, allow Gestalts to possess your Backup Chassis and become your spectrobotic minions. WX-78 learns to craft the Spectral Transfer Module.

×12

The Spectral Transfer Module can be installed on any Backup Chassis. When any Gestalts come nearby, it will possess the Chassis, turning them into WX-78 followers. Alternatively, the player can manually puts an Encapsulated Gestalt in it (except for the Encapsulated Celestial Revenant). After the possession, it will drop the module, making it reusable.

The possessed chassis will have all of its plugged-in circuits active, even if the chassis has insufficient charges. All Circuit Tinkering skills also affect the possessed chassis.

WX-78 can open the possessed chassis's inventory to give it various items. The chassis can hold weapons, wear armor, and consume food that the player gives/feeds it. It only deals 50% damage with weapons (or 25% damage with shadow weapons), and this modifier also affects weapons' Planar damage, but the chassis also consumes half the durability of the weapons. It will switch to the highest damage/range weapon in its inventory when fighting and to appropriate tools when working.

If the chassis was possessed by a Gestalt from the Lunar Rift (i.e Grazer or Incursive Gestalts), it gains Planar Entity Protection and deals full Planar damage with weapons instead of half.

The possessed chassis have a 50% resistance to negative sanity auras (75% with Planar possessed one).

When WX-78 moves to another shard or leaves the server, the possessed chassis temporarily deactivates, reactivating itself when the player gets back. The chassis becomes unpossessed if it dies, if its owner dies, when it is force-hit by its owner, or if it reaches 0 . If this happens, it must be repossessed by a new Gestalt (whether wild or captive).

Additionally, WX-78 and their possessed Backup Chassis gain +10% damage against Shadow Aligned creatures and +10% damage protection against Lunar Aligned creatures.


Shadow Servitor
  • Find and defeat the Ancient Fuelweaver.
  • Have no lunar affinity.
  • Be able to craft a Backup Chassis.
 Allows insertion of select shadow components into your circuitry, granting your Chassis various abilities in both inhabited and uninhabited states. WX-78 can "Implant" certain Shadow items into their unique circuitry slots, granting them with some special abilities: When implanting a Nightmare Fuel, WX-78 unlocks the Auto-Grabber recipe, a drone which assists WX-78 in picking up and harvesting items, similar to the Lazy Forager. With Pure Horror, WX-78 can craft 4 Auto-Grabbers at a time instead of 2.
When implanting a Shadow Atrium, WX-78 unlocks the Exploiterator recipe, a drone which continuously scans an enemy to debuff it. Each drone scanning a target causes that enemy to take 6% more physical damage from WX-78, for a maximum of 18% extra damage with 3 Exploiterators. With the Possessed Shadow Atrium, WX-78 can craft 4 Exploiterators instead of 3 (resulting in up to 24% more damage).
Additonally, with the Possessed Shadow Atrium, WX-78 gains the ability to use mimicked items produced by Mimicreeps without them getting revealed.

When in uninhabited states, the chassis will works like a stationary W.O.B.O.T. with a Nightmare Fuel/Pure Horror imbued. With a Shadow Atrium implanted, the Chassis will periodically grow Shadow Atrium Tendrils around itself, which can be chopped for biome-dependent loot similar to that from Boulderbough. With the Possessed Shadow Atrium, the chassis also produces Mimicreeps that will copy nearby equippable items.

With this skill, WX-78 can also consume Nightmare Fuel to temporarily fully charge their charge meter for 15 seconds (or 60 seconds when consuming Pure Horror). Missing charges will still recharge in the background while the shadow battery is active. However, the shadow battery will not work with the Inhabited Machine II skill (where WX-78 leaves behind a Backup Chassis instead of a Skeleton when dying at full charge); WX-78 must still have a full charge without the shadow battery.

Additionally, WX-78 gains +10% damage against Lunar Aligned creatures and +10% damage protection against Shadow Aligned creatures.

Tips

  • WX-78 players may want to avoid using items that offer Lightning immunity (such as the Eyebrella or Rain Coat) if they require healing, though they will take a hit to their sanity with each strike.
    • An Umbrella paired with any wetness protection clothes or armor (such as a Football Helmet or Miner Hat) can provide rain protection without lightning immunity.
  • Using the Ice Cube or Fashion Melon as protection from Overheating is not advised, as the Wetness gained from those items will damage WX-78.
  • Rain damage causes WX-78 to periodically emit light as sparks fly off their body. The light emitted is frequent and bright enough to prevent Charlie from attacking, but comes at the cost of large amounts of Sanity due to being in complete darkness.
  • WX-78's Gear-consumption ability, light-providing circuits, and decreased Clockwork aggression makes them one of the better-equipped characters for traversing the Ruins. They can also use Roto-Mappers to locate the Ruins more easily to begin with.
  • Since they ignore spoilage and food loses all sanity restoration as soon as it turns stale, WX-78 players have at least double the time to utilize foods that grant high sanity but spoil quickly, such as Jelly Salad, giving them a distinct advantage over other characters in terms of sanity management.
  • WX-78 can recruit three of each Clockwork follower instead of the usual two.
